movie.title: Hacksaw Ridge
movie.overview: WWII American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, who served during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first Conscientious Objector in American history to receive the Congressional Medal of Honor.

facts: Desmond Doss's incredible refusal to carry a weapon during WWII wasn't just a personal stance; it was deeply rooted in his faith as a Seventh-day Adventist. Talk about sticking to your convictions!

While *Hacksaw Ridge* tells an amazing true story, many might not know it's actually based on a pre-existing film! The movie drew its inspiration from a 2004 documentary simply titled *The Conscientious Objector*.

The powerful screenplay that brought Desmond Doss's heroism to life was crafted by the talented writing duo of Andrew Knight and Robert Schenkkan. They really did an incredible job telling such a unique story!
